title: Navisworks Technical Coordination Workflow
trigger: Federated desktop coordination is required for heavy assembly, clash execution, viewpoint review, or evidence packaging.

steps.action: Create or update the NWF coordination container and verify shared-coordinate alignment.
Apply governed search/selection sets and define discipline-pair clash tests.
Execute clash matrix, deduplicate results, and prepare review viewpoints.
Use curated viewpoints during coordination review and synchronize formal issues to the governed system of record.
Re-test remediated conditions and package milestone evidence.

system_of_record_boundary: Navisworks-only logs are not authoritative for formal acceptance; formal coordination issues must be synchronized to the governed issue system of record.

provenance.migration_note: Desktop implementation retained separately from core S5 doctrine. Incomplete source TODOs are not promoted.
